events.title: Elvis Presley: A Legacy That Rocks On
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who would have been 91.

angles.name: Elvis Remembered
angles.copy: On this day, we remember the unparalleled impact of Elvis Presley. His music continues to define generations. Which track of his is your all-time favourite?

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: We mark the anniversary of the tragic shooting of hip-hop icon Tupac Shakur, who would have been 55.

angles.name: Tupac's Impact
angles.copy: It's 25 years since the music world lost Tupac Shakur. His lyrics and influence are still felt across the globe. What's the one Tupac track that still resonates with you?

events.title: Jimi Hendrix: Guitar Legend Remembered
events.blurb: On this day, we remember the passing of the revolutionary guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who would have been 84.

angles.name: Hendrix's Genius
angles.copy: A true pioneer, Jimi Hendrix redefined what was possible with a guitar. On the anniversary of his passing, we celebrate his enduring genius. What's your go-to Hendrix riff?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Magic
angles.copy: 57 years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. From 'Come Together' to 'Here Comes the Sun', it's a masterpiece. What's your favourite track from the album?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The legendary frontwoman of The Pretenders, Chrissie Hynde, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the one and only Chrissie Hynde! Her voice and style are unmistakable. What's your favourite Pretenders hit?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and rock 'n' roll icon Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Always entertaining, always rock and roll. What's your favourite Oasis or solo track from him?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: 51 years ago, John Lennon released 'Imagine', a song that still resonates with its powerful message of peace and unity. What does this song mean to you?

events.title: The iPod's 25th Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple released the first-generation iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: iPod Memories
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? 25 years ago, it changed how we carried our music. What was the first album you loaded onto your iPod?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the release of the very first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond Moment
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to legendary theme tunes, what's your favourite 007 moment or song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: We remember John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we pay tribute to the incredible John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire. What's his most impactful song for you?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! A true master of comedy, from Monty Python to Fawlty Towers. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Deep Dive
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles unveiled 'The White Album'. Its eclectic mix still fascinates. What's your favourite hidden gem from this double LP?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: We mark the anniversary of the passing of Queen's iconic frontman, Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80.

angles.name: Freddie's Unforgettable Voice
angles.copy: On this day, we remember the one and only Freddie Mercury. His voice, stage presence, and legacy are truly immortal. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their influential album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Evolution
angles.copy: 61 years ago, The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' marked a significant shift in their sound. A pivotal album. What's your favourite track from this classic?
